papers_opened.does_not: Does not decompose the shift or test whether unlabelled remedies can work without target labels; method paper, abstract only

papers_opened.does: SofaNet: cross-centre collaborative learning with SOFA auxiliary task and hidden-space alignment for data-scarce hospitals; MIMIC-III + Challenge

papers_opened.does: Local retraining recovers discrimination after CHOP→GOSH sepsis model transfer (GB 0.86 vs 0.87)
papers_opened.does_not: Paediatric, private data; no decomposition; retraining with full local data

papers_opened.does: Compares generalisation, fine-tuning, retraining, target training, supervised DA and fusion training over 4 target sizes on HiRID/MIMIC-IV/eICU; fine-tuning worst
papers_opened.does_not: Makes candidate #2 crowded. Does NOT decompose covariate vs conditional shift and does NOT test unsupervised remedies or label-free performance estimation

papers_opened.does: Missingness identifies the hospital; XGBoost 0.725→0.608 A→B on PhysioNet 2019; ablation without observation indicators
papers_opened.does_not: Focus on missingness and explanation transport; does not show vitals-only failure, pooled recoverability, IW failure or harmonisation artefacts (from abstract)

papers_opened.read: full text (arXiv 2303.02011 PDF; method + support/overlap sections)
papers_opened.title: Diagnosing Model Performance Under Distribution Shift
papers_opened.does: DISDE decomposes a train-to-target performance change into harder-but-seen inputs, Y|X change and unseen input regions, using a domain classifier on a shared distribution; applied to employment (ACS) and satellite images.
papers_opened.does_not: Requires a shared-support distribution estimated by a domain classifier (degenerates when domain AUC ~1) and does not use a within-hospital different-unit control or clinical multi-site ICU data.

papers_opened.read: full text (ICML PMLR PDF / arXiv; method + eICU case study)
papers_opened.title: "Why did the Model Fail?": Attributing Model Performance Changes to Distribution Shifts
papers_opened.does: Shapley attribution of performance change to shifts in causal-graph mechanisms via importance weighting; includes an eICU mortality case study (Midwest->South, 4 hospitals each, Brier score).
papers_opened.does_not: Needs importance weights (overlap) and an assumed causal graph; attributes to P(X)/P(Y|X) mechanisms, not to a site vs population contrast built from a factorial unit x hospital design.

papers_opened.read: full text (arXiv PDF; method + real-data sections)
papers_opened.title: A hierarchical decomposition for explaining ML performance discrepancies
papers_opened.does: Nonparametric aggregate (p(X) vs p(Y|X)) and variable-level decomposition of performance gaps with debiased estimators and CIs; readmission (general -> heart-failure population, one safety-net hospital) and ACS insurance case studies.
papers_opened.does_not: Assumes positivity/bounded density ratios; its clinical example is a within-hospital population shift only, with no between-hospital arm and no factorial control.

papers_opened.title: A new framework to enhance the interpretation of external validation studies of clinical prediction models
papers_opened.does: Three-step framework: quantify relatedness (case-mix differences, membership model) between development and validation samples, assess performance, interpret on a reproducibility-transportability scale; DVT example with 3 validation samples.
papers_opened.does_not: Interprets case-mix qualitatively per validation sample; no explicit site-vs-population decomposition of an AUROC drop and no within-site different-unit control.

papers_opened.title: External Validity of Risk Models: Use of Benchmark Values to Disentangle a Case-Mix Effect From Incorrect Coefficients
papers_opened.does: Proposes case-mix-corrected benchmark values (e.g. expected c-statistic under the validation case mix) to separate case-mix effects from incorrect coefficients; traumatic brain injury trials.
papers_opened.does_not: Relies on model-based benchmark (assumes the model's predicted risks are correct in the new sample); regression-model setting, not ML early warning, no site vs unit factorial.

papers_opened.title: Assessing Discriminative Performance at External Validation of Clinical Prediction Models
papers_opened.does: Simulation + 15 TBI datasets comparing a permutation test with case-mix benchmark c-statistics; concludes one must disentangle case-mix differences from incorrect coefficients.
papers_opened.does_not: Benchmark-value approach within logistic models; no empirical split into site vs population components and no ICU/sepsis data.

papers_opened.title: Accommodating population differences when validating risk prediction models
papers_opened.does: Formalises reproducibility/transportability and proposes weighted validation metrics adjusting for predictor-distribution and outcome-verification differences; prostate cancer screening trials.
papers_opened.does_not: Weighting requires covariate overlap between populations; not applicable when domain AUC ~1 and does not use a design-based (factorial) contrast.

papers_opened.title: Propensity-based standardization to enhance the validation and interpretation of prediction model discrimination for a target population
papers_opened.does: Propensity-weighted c-statistics standardised for case mix to separate lack of generalisability from case-mix differences; 8 DVT models x 12 validation sets + simulation; unbiased only with flexible PS and positivity.
papers_opened.does_not: Explicitly needs positivity (fails without overlap, our setting); DVT not ICU; no within-hospital unit control.

papers_opened.title: Distinguishing case-mix from context heterogeneity in prognostic regression model synthesis settings
papers_opened.does: Partitions coefficient heterogeneity across sites into case-mix vs site-context components via local regressions in an autoencoder latent space; COPD trial with two sites, permuted-site negative control.
papers_opened.does_not: Targets regression-coefficient heterogeneity in model synthesis, not transported AUROC of an early-warning model; no unit x hospital factorial; two-site COPD only.

papers_opened.title: Rethinking external validation for the target population: Capturing patient-level similarity with a generative model
papers_opened.does: Autoencoder-based patient similarity to development data; reports external performance by similarity subgroup to separate model deficiency from case mix; Netherlands Heart Registration TAVI mortality.
papers_opened.does_not: Similarity-stratification still needs overlapping patients; no site vs population decomposition by design, no ICU/sepsis.

papers_opened.title: A causal viewpoint on prediction model performance under changes in case-mix: discrimination and calibration respond differently for prognosis and diagnosis predictions
papers_opened.does: Causal framework: under case-mix shift, prognostic (causal-direction) models keep calibration but not discrimination, diagnostic the reverse; simulation + cardiovascular models.
papers_opened.does_not: Theory of case-mix effects only; does not estimate a site component or use multi-site ICU data.

papers_opened.title: The Impact of Multi-Institution Datasets on the Generalizability of Machine Learning Prediction Models in the ICU
papers_opened.does: Harmonised (ricu) AUMCdb/HiRID/eICU/MIMIC; DL models for mortality, AKI, sepsis; AUROC drops up to 0.20 at new datasets, pooling helps, DG methods do not; notes MICU vs SICU case-mix differences and recommends an external 'oracle' model.
papers_opened.does_not: Does not separate site from case-mix components; dataset = site and unit type confounded (discussed, not designed around).

papers_opened.title: Generalizability challenges of mortality risk prediction models: A retrospective analysis on a multi-center database
papers_opened.does: eICU 179 hospitals: cross-hospital AUC IQR 0.777-0.832, calibration slope and FNR disparities; FCI causal discovery shows distribution and race-mediated relationship differences by hospital/region.
papers_opened.does_not: Describes between-hospital gaps and their correlates; no within-hospital unit contrast and no decomposition of the gap into site vs population parts.

papers_opened.title: Generalizability of predictive models for intensive care unit patients
papers_opened.does: eICU: multi-centre cross-validation estimates performance at new centres; pooled model transfers well even versus hospital-specific retraining.
papers_opened.does_not: Between-hospital only, no unit-type stratification or site vs population decomposition.

papers_opened.title: Transportability of bacterial infection prediction models for critically ill patients
papers_opened.does: BI risk model transported between MIMIC, Northwestern tertiary ICUs and NM community ICUs; MIMIC model transports worse (0.74), attributed 'likely' to case-mix; multisite learning stabilises.
papers_opened.does_not: Case-mix attribution is informal; tertiary vs community within the same system is a partial within-system contrast but is not crossed with hospital system nor used to estimate components.

papers_opened.title: External validation of AI-based scoring systems in the ICU: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers_opened.venue: BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making
papers_opened.does: Review of 572 ICU ML studies: 14.7% externally validated, mean external AUROC change -0.037; flags reliance on MIMIC/eICU and implicit case-mix differences.
papers_opened.does_not: Documents the problem; does not decompose drops into site vs case-mix.

papers_opened.title: Early Prediction of Sepsis From Clinical Data: The PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology Challenge 2019
papers_opened.does: Describes the Challenge (hospital systems A, B public; C hidden), utility score, 104 teams; concludes generalisability to different hospital systems remains a challenge.
papers_opened.does_not: Reports between-system generalisation only; no unit-level (MICU/SICU) analysis or decomposition.

papers_opened.title: Predicting sepsis using deep learning across international sites: a retrospective development and validation study
papers_opened.does: Harmonised MIMIC/eICU/HiRID/AUMCdb sepsis DL model: internal AUC 0.846 vs external 0.761, 10% fine-tuning gives 0.807.
papers_opened.does_not: No attribution of the external drop to site vs case mix; database = site, unit types not crossed.

papers_opened.title: Dynamic Prediction of ICU Mortality Risk Using Domain Adaptation
papers_opened.does: Treats MIMIC ICU types (e.g. cardiac, medical, surgical) as domains and uses domain adaptation for cross-ICU-population mortality prediction.
papers_opened.does_not: Within-hospital unit transfer only; no between-hospital arm, no decomposition of a transport gap.

papers_opened.title: Learning Tasks for Multitask Learning: Heterogenous Patient Populations in the ICU
papers_opened.does: Learns patient subgroups and multitask mortality models in MIMIC-III; highlights heterogeneous care-unit populations and per-group evaluation.
papers_opened.does_not: Single hospital; no transport/site analysis.

papers_opened.title: Missingness-Aware Conformal Prediction Under Cross-Hospital Distribution Shift
papers_opened.does: Missingness-grouped Mondrian conformal calibration for mortality, evaluated across eICU hospitals and, separately, across six care units within one MIMIC-IV hospital; hospital-level decomposition of pooled vs within-hospital coverage.
papers_opened.does_not: Within-hospital-unit and between-hospital settings are separate datasets, not crossed; outcome is conformal coverage, not decomposition of an AUROC transport gap.

papers_opened.title: Causal Attribution of Model Performance Gaps in Medical Imaging Under Distribution Shifts
papers_opened.does: Shapley causal attribution of MS-lesion segmentation gaps to acquisition (centre) vs annotation (annotator) mechanisms across 4 centres x 7 annotators.
papers_opened.does_not: Crossed centre x annotator design in imaging is the nearest analogue to our factorial idea, but it is segmentation, not ICU tabular early warning, and attributes via a causal graph rather than an overlap-free unit x hospital contrast.

papers_opened.title: Cross-database validation reveals distinct layers of transportability in ICU delirium prediction
papers_opened.does: Bidirectional eICU<->MIMIC-IV delirium models: AUROC 0.87-0.92 internally to 0.66-0.83 external; ranking, probability and policy transport diverge.
papers_opened.does_not: Layers of transport (ranking/calibration/policy), not site vs population; no unit control.

papers_opened.title: Multi-environment evaluation and decision-level analysis of clinical prediction models under dataset shift
papers_opened.does: MIMIC-III demo vs eICU mortality with explicit feature mappings/harmonisation; eICU->MIMIC AUC 0.60-0.64 and threshold failures.
papers_opened.does_not: Tiny cohort; harmonisation is a preprocessing step, not tested as a remedy for a measured site component.

papers_opened.title: An empirical framework for domain generalization in clinical settings
papers_opened.does: Benchmarks 8 DG methods on multi-site clinical time series (eICU) and imaging with induced shifts; DG rarely beats ERM.
papers_opened.does_not: Tests DG (needs multiple training domains) on overall OOD performance, not label-free fixes of a site component isolated by a unit control.

papers_opened.title: Observation-process features are associated with larger domain shift in sepsis mortality prediction: a cross-database evaluation using MIMIC-IV and eICU-CRD
papers_opened.does: MIMIC-IV->eICU sepsis mortality, 7 specifications with/without measurement counts; with LR, removing counts shrinks the external AUROC drop (e.g. -0.047 vs -0.082) and improves calibration slope; smaller incremental effect for gradient-boosted trees (abstract).
papers_opened.does_not: No formal decomposition and no unit-type/within-hospital control, so it cannot say what fraction of a site component the removal fixes.
papers_opened.spot_check: 2026-11-24 lead agent: numbers verified against medRxiv API abstract; GBT wording corrected

papers_opened.title: Domain generalization and adaptation in intensive care with anchor regression
papers_opened.venue: RSS Data Science and Artificial Intelligence
papers_opened.does: Anchor regression/boosting on ~400k patients from 9 harmonised ICU databases; modest OOD gains for most dissimilar targets; identifies DG/DA/data-rich regimes by target sample size; discusses ward and admission type as alternative anchors.
papers_opened.does_not: Uses multi-source training with dataset-ID anchors and target labels for regimes; does not isolate a site component or test single-source label-free fixes.

papers_opened.title: Evaluation of domain generalization and adaptation on improving model robustness to temporal dataset shift in clinical medicine
papers_opened.does: MIMIC-IV year groups; sepsis shows largest temporal AUROC drop (0.090); DG and UDA (unlabelled target) fail to beat ERM.
papers_opened.does_not: Temporal shift in one hospital, not site shift; no unit control.

papers_opened.title: An Adversarial Domain Separation Framework for Septic Shock Early Prediction Across EHR Systems
papers_opened.does: Adversarial domain-separation VRNN separating covariate shift (populations) from systematic bias (data collection) for septic shock across two US EHR systems; improves both.
papers_opened.does_not: Conceptually separates population vs collection shift but via a learned representation using labels in both systems; no measured decomposition or unit control.

papers_opened.title: Feature Robustness in Non-stationary Health Records: Caveats to Deployable Model Performance in Common Clinical Machine Learning Tasks
papers_opened.does: MIMIC-III with year of care: models decay after 2008 record-keeping change (0.29 AUROC drop); aggregating raw items into clinical concepts cuts the drop to 0.06.
papers_opened.does_not: Temporal/record-system shift within one hospital, not cross-hospital site shift; no unit control.

papers_opened.title: Yet Another ICU Benchmark: A Flexible Multi-Center Framework for Clinical ML
papers_opened.does: Multi-dataset ICU benchmark (MIMIC III/IV, eICU, HiRID, AUMCdb) with harmonised cohorts/preprocessing; dataset/cohort/preprocessing choices matter more than model class.
papers_opened.does_not: Infrastructure; does not quantify site vs population components or test fixes against them.

papers_opened.title: Shortcut learning in medical AI hinders generalization: method for estimating AI model generalization without external data
papers_opened.does: Across 13 imaging/ECG/text/audio datasets, shortcut learning of data-acquisition bias inflates performance ~20%; proposes bias-corrected external accuracy estimate P_Est within ~4%.
papers_opened.does_not: Estimates external accuracy without external data for unstructured data, not AUROC of ICU tabular early warning at a specific new hospital.

papers_opened.title: Leveraging Unlabeled Data to Predict Out-of-Distribution Performance
papers_opened.does: ATC: threshold on confidence learned on source to predict target accuracy; evaluated on WILDS (FMoW, RxRx1, Amazon, CivilComments), ImageNet, BREEDS, CIFAR, MNIST; proves estimation is as hard as identifying the optimal predictor without assumptions.
papers_opened.does_not: Accuracy only, vision/text benchmarks; no clinical multi-site EHR or AUROC evaluation.

papers_opened.title: Predicting with Confidence on Unseen Distributions
papers_opened.does: Difference of Confidences (DoC) predicts accuracy change under shift better than distributional distances; ImageNet variants.
papers_opened.does_not: Image classification accuracy; no clinical tabular data or AUROC.

papers_opened.title: Label-free estimation of clinically relevant performance metrics under distribution shifts
papers_opened.does: Extends ATC/DoC/CBPE to confusion-matrix estimation (PPV, NPV, AUC approximation) and benchmarks on chest X-ray (CheXpert->PadChest etc.) real and simulated shifts; prevalence shifts expose systematic failures.
papers_opened.does_not: Imaging only; no ICU/EHR multi-hospital evaluation, no importance weighting, no sepsis.

papers_opened.title: Extensive benchmarking of a method that estimates external model performance from limited statistical characteristics
papers_opened.does: Weights the internal cohort to match external summary statistics and estimates external AUROC, calibration and Brier across 5 US data sources; 95th-percentile AUROC error 0.03.
papers_opened.does_not: Closest clinical label-free-ish estimator, but uses OMOP claims/EHR sources with summary statistics (whether outcome statistics are used: UNVERIFIED from abstract), not ICU time series with near-zero covariate overlap; does not test ATC/DoC.

papers_opened.title: Estimating Model Performance Under Covariate Shift Without Labels
papers_opened.does: PAPE: label-free estimation of confusion-matrix metrics under covariate shift via density-ratio-adapted calibration; >900 US census dataset-model pairs.
papers_opened.does_not: Census data; relies on covariate-shift/density ratios, no clinical multi-site evaluation.

papers_opened.title: Performance Estimation in Binary Classification Using Calibrated Confidence
papers_opened.does: CBPE: estimates any confusion-matrix metric from calibrated confidence with distributions/CIs.
papers_opened.does_not: Assumes calibration holds in target; no clinical cross-hospital evaluation, no AUROC.

papers_opened.title: Confidence-based Estimators for Predictive Performance in Model Monitoring
papers_opened.does: Shows Average Confidence is unbiased/consistent under assumptions, adds CIs; synthetic covariate-shift experiments, estimator quality case-dependent.
papers_opened.does_not: Synthetic data only; no clinical sites.

papers_opened.title: Estimating performance for safe deployment of machine learning models
papers_opened.does: MOVAL: class-wise calibrated confidence ensemble estimating accuracy, F1, AUC on unlabelled shifted natural and medical images.
papers_opened.does_not: Imaging acquisition shifts; not ICU tabular multi-hospital.

papers_opened.title: Detecting and Remediating Harmful Data Shifts for the Responsible Deployment of Clinical AI Models
papers_opened.does: 7 Toronto hospitals GIM mortality: label-agnostic shift detection (BBSD + MMD), shifts incl. community->academic; transfer/continual learning remediation.
papers_opened.does_not: Detects shift without labels but does not estimate AUROC without labels; remediation uses labels.

papers_opened.title: Avoiding Biased Clinical Machine Learning Model Performance Estimates in the Presence of Label Selection
papers_opened.does: Weighting estimators recover AUROC under label selection in simulated and lab-test deployment scenarios.
papers_opened.does_not: Label-selection (partially labelled) setting within one site, not label-free cross-hospital estimation.

papers_opened.title: Cross-site transportability of an explainable artificial intelligence model for acute kidney injury prediction
papers_opened.does: PCORnet AKI model across 6 health systems; deterioration attributed to risk-factor heterogeneity; derives a method to predict transportability.
papers_opened.does_not: Transportability prediction for AKI across systems, not ICU sepsis; no evaluation of ATC/DoC/IW error; no unit control.
